query: The dashboard has 42 alerts, including one for every customer_id and one for each transient retry. The on-call team ignores most notifications. Reduce alert noise without hiding a real checkout outage.
expected_behavior: Identifies customer_id and retry-level alert dimensions as high-cardinality or noisy signals that belong in diagnostic detail rather than paging metrics
Groups alerts around user-visible symptoms and actionable SLO burn or golden-signal thresholds
Defines routing, ownership, and a response action for each retained page
Keeps a dashboard or log query for diagnosis and does not silence the checkout outage signal
